adjudication.why: The compatibility CLI already uses picocli.exit(result.exitCode()); the new feature-disabled branch follows the same CLI exit convention and returns immediately. No embedding caller or broken contract is identified by the truncated label.

promotion_candidates.title: Operator side of the preview feature is never gated — docs claim a failure that no code produces
promotion_candidates.description: CAUTION documents that rolling-updates must be enabled in the operator, but no operator code reads the flag. UpgradeLogicFactory only checks spec.update.strategy, not the feature flag. The documented remedy (setting features.enabled) cannot work because it only affects server container args, not the operator's Profile. CLI commands are gated but operator path remains ungated.

promotion_candidates.title: Documented --features=rolling-updates on update-compatibility is ignored on distributions built with --features
promotion_candidates.description: The --features flag is build-time; persisted build values override CLI values. Pre-built distributions with explicit features ignore the documented --features=rolling-updates flag and require a rebuild instead. The flag also replaces rather than extends existing features, contradicting the guide's own warning to include all configuration options. CI doesn't catch this because tests run against unbuilt distributions.
